svg.title: Two-way sync between CRM, Supabase and Shopify
svg.desc: CRM app reads and writes Supabase. A sync layer of Edge Functions moves data between Supabase and Shopify: webhooks inbound today, pushes outbound planned.
svg.text: Planned: CRM edits pushed to Shopify

g.text: Conflict rule: Shopify wins on next sync. CRM keeps notes, tags, thresholds.
